title: Shadax Client Automods
description: A private modpack to connect to servers running automodpack. This contains useful client-side mods, as well as automodpack to maitnain parity with your server.
body:
A modpack designed to connect to a server running [AutoModpack](https://modrinth.com/mod/automodpack).

> AutoModpack is the ultimate Minecraft modification designed to revolutionize private server modpack management. Say goodbye to the days of struggling to get everyone on the same version! This mod automatically synchronizes players with the server's modpack, making playing with friends incredibly smooth and hassle-free.

This contains a set of what I consider absolutely necessary client-side mods for any modded playthrough, as well as select resource packs and shaders that I've come to love.

Utilities:
- [Just Enough Items](https://modrinth.com/mod/jei)
- [Better Modlist](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-modlist)
- [Better F3](https://modrinth.com/mod/betterf3)
- [Chat Image](https://modrinth.com/mod/chatimage)
- [Screenshot Viewer](https://modrinth.com/mod/screenshot-viewer), [Screenshot to Clipboard](https://modrinth.com/mod/screenshot-to-clipboard), [Screenshot Compression](https://modrinth.com/mod/screenshot-compression)

Gameplay Fixes:
- [Accurate Block Placement](https://modrinth.com/mod/reforged-accurate-block-placement)
- [Apple Skin](https://modrinth.com/mod/appleskin)
- [Client Sort](https://modrinth.com/mod/clientsort)
- [Mouse Tweaks](https://modrinth.com/mod/mouse-tweaks)
- [OK Zoomer](https://modrinth.com/mod/ok-zoomer)
- [Colorful Hearts](https://modrinth.com/mod/colorful-hearts)

Client Side Performance:
- [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium), [Sodium Extra](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium-extra), [Sodium Shadowy Paths](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium-shadowy-path-blocks), [Sodium Dynamic Lights](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium-dynamic-lights), [Reeses Sodium Options](https://modrinth.com/mod/reeses-sodium-options)
- [Enhanced Block Entities](https://modrinth.com/mod/ebe)
- [Entity Culling](https://modrinth.com/mod/entityculling)
- [Dynamic FPS](https://modrinth.com/mod/dynamic-fps)

Visuals:
- [Better Clouds](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-clouds)
- [Iris](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris), [Complimentary Shaders](https://modrinth.com/shader/complementary-reimagined), [Euphoria Patches](https://modrinth.com/mod/euphoria-patches)
- [Wakes](https://modrinth.com/mod/wakes-reforged)
- [Better Biome Blend](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-biome-blend)
- [Particle Rain](https://modrinth.com/mod/particle-rain)

Resource Packs:
- [Vanilla Tweaks](https://vanillatweaks.net/)
- [Enhanced Audio](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/enhanced-audio), [Enhanced Audio: Ambience](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/enhanced-audio-ambience)
- [Fancy Crops](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fancy-crops)
- [Serious Reanimated](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/serious-reanimated)
- [C418 Songs Only](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/c418-songs-only)

And many more...



This version is running with NeoForge 1.21.1
